commits.purpose: Bounded product repairs and canonical regression tests; exact final wave2 manifest
Mission report, compact proof receipts, immutable manifests and frozen offline reproducibility inputs/tools

selfManifest.reason: A file cannot contain its own final SHA without a cycle; root must hash this manifest externally immediately before staging.

reportReview.pendingMarkersAreNotAutomaticallyFailure: Some PENDING mentions can describe historical evidence. Root must complete current final fields and refresh this manifest after final report edit.
reportReview.postCommitReceiptExpected: final-state.json created after documentation commit to record actual FINAL_HEAD

risksOfLocalOnlyProofs: A fresh checkout retains receipts and hashes but cannot reconstruct omitted raw provider request/response exchanges, complete runtime sessions, logs or diagnostic traces. Hashes detect drift; they do not recover missing bytes.

Historical exact-live replay depends on .provider-evidence.local and prior validation directories already local/untracked or ignored. Commit2 does not silently import those 533 baseline files or 34 protected live artifacts.

The mandate attachment is outside the repository, and current Markdown links use an absolute /Users/charles/... workspace path; they will not resolve unchanged on another workstation. Provenance is retained but portable rendering is not guaranteed.

Full raw browser click/screenshot/AX evidence cannot be reconstructed from compact observation receipts alone. Browser-http-exchanges.jsonl is local-only and must be archived with its SHA for forensic reinspection.

Campaign vitest glob includes the typed historical red probe if that file is later added or run locally. The red original copy is preserved as .original and excluded from green test execution; use explicit green test paths.
No unrequested external upload or deletion is performed. Keep a non-destructive local archive of all excluded artifacts; decide its durable backup separately.
stagingRules: Do not git add the whole worktree or validation folder. Stage only commits[order].paths, separately.
Before commit1, rehash 16 source files against captured SHA; before commit2, rehash every included file after final report/browser consolidation.
Do not force-add .provider-evidence.local, runtime dump directories, logs, large session files or resume-state.json.
The second commit depends on the first for code and types. The first contains canonical tests without importing the campaign corpus, preserving the requested 16-path boundary.
If any captured SHA changes, stop that commit preparation and regenerate the explicit manifest; this is a local preparation artifact, not an authorization to stage or commit.
